messages:
Clara (People Ops): Hey team — quick policy Q. Emily had to book a hotel in Madrid last-minute and the hotel’s merchant blocked the corporate AMEX, so she paid on her personal card. She put her spouse on the same reservation (one room, two guests). The receipt is a single line for €420 and the booking ref is `CONF123456`. Questions: 1) can we reimburse only the business portion? 2) vendor gave an invoice with the company name but not an itemized split — can Finance reclaim VAT? 3) Emily's manager (Diego) is OOO until Monday — who can approve this high-value expense (> $1k equivalent) in the meantime? Thanks.

Sam (Finance): Short answer: yes to reimbursing business portion only, but we need evidence to justify the split. If there's no per-guest line item, we usually prorate by nights attended or request a corrected invoice. For VAT: if the invoice contains Redwood's VAT ID, we can attempt reclaim, but we need the supplier's VAT invoice (supplier name, VAT number, line items). If not present, VAT reclaim is unlikely.

Sam (Finance): Action items for Emily: 1) upload the full hotel folio/receipt + booking confirmation screenshot showing guest names, 2) add a short note in the expense "room split — spouse personal share", 3) indicate number of nights that were business vs personal. Finance will mark VAT recoverable only if invoice has VAT details. :white_check_mark:

Diego (Manager): I’m on call and can approve remotely now — Emily, go ahead and submit and tag me. I approve the business portion based on the conference nights (2 nights). I don’t approve spouse charges. If Sam needs an explicit delegate, I give provisional approval here. :thumbsup:

Priya (People Ops): For clarity on process: if manager is fully OOO and cannot approve, you should request temporary delegation via `finance-approvals@redwood.com` and CC people-ops@redwood.com with the expense link. We’ll triage approvals for up to $2k for urgent reimbursements. Also attach the booking page showing the folio name and a short statement of business purpose (conference + dates).

Expensify Bot: Reminder — please submit within 30 days of travel. Upload files: hotel folio (PDF), booking confirmation (screenshot), and a short line item in the expense description like `split-room: €210 personal share`. Tag: `split-room`. Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#split-room

Clara (People Ops): Thanks — Emily, can you add the folio and booking screenshot here and submit? I’ll follow up with finance if they need a supplier-corrected invoice for VAT reclaim. If Finance can’t reclaim VAT, we’ll still reimburse the net business amount (without VAT) per policy and note it in the report.

Emily (via DM to Clara): Uploaded the folio and screenshot to Expensify just now — booking shows two names but no itemization. — Clara: got it, I’ll kick off the delegation email to finance-approvals and CC you.
